The Lunch Lady (Danny Phantom) is the ghost of a lunch lady from Casper High who grows enfuriated when changes are brought to her cafeteria lunch menu. She is able to summon and control food, mostly using raw meat as a weapon and armor. 
 Charlotte Katakuri (One Piece) is the second son of the Charlotte Family and one of the 3 Sweet Generals. Much like most of the Charlotte children, Katakuri ate a Devil Fruit, that being the Mochi Mochi no Mi (Mochi-Mochi Fruit), a special Paramecia fruit that allows him to generate and turn any part of his body into extremely sticky mochi and manipulate it as he wishes.
